jobs.occupation: Software Engineer (f/m/d) - Life Science and Diagnostics (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Overview  

 
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  

We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams. 
 
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you. 

 

At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact. 

 

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. 

‎

About this opportunity

In the position of a (Junior) Software Engineer (f/m/d) in Life Science and Diagnostics at QIAGEN, you will be making improvements in life possible – every working day. We are looking for you to help us shape our product development with skill and passion. You will work with our system and software teams to develop instrument control software for laboratory devices as well as data analysis software to process test results helping our customers to get valuable insights from a biological sample.

Your Tasks
* As a Software Engineer you will typically work in project teams of 5-10 people and gain experience in different roles throughout the life cycle of a software development project.
* You will start as a software developer or (automated) software tester in one of our scrum teams. Throught your professional career you will have the opportunity to grow into senior roles such as senior engineer, product owner, software architect or verification manager.  
* You will work across teams and across sites to generate the best possible solution for our products in a complex environment of Biology, Chemistry, Mechanics, Electronics and Software.
* You will be based at QIAGEN Hilden, our operational headquarter and will have the opportunity to visit our international development sites in Aarhus, Denmark or Wroclaw, Poland to strengthen and refine your software development capabilities.

Your Profile
* You have a master’s degree in computer science, with a minor in medicine, science or engineering
* You show a strong interest in software and product development and have already gained first professional experience.
* You love science and have a strong analytical mindset that strives to analyze, understand and solve problems.
* You are highly organized, work independently and easily adapt to changing work environment.
* You show excellent communication skills in both, English and German (C1 level)
* Ideally, you are familiar with working with AI-powered development tools or large language models to automate software development lifecycle processes. Experience with connecting AI agents with third-party systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP) is a plus

Please provide a transcript of record and an employer's reference if applicable.

What we offer  

 

* Bonus/Commission  

* Local benefits   

* Referral Program  

* Volunteer Day  

* Internal Academy (QIALearn)   

* Employee Assistance Program   

* Hybrid work (conditional to your role) 

 

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.   

 

QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

jobs.occupation: Chemical Quality & Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Chemical Quality & Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) Are you
ready to design, build, and run a state-of-the-art analytical
chemistry laboratory from the ground up? As a Chemical Quality &
Laboratory Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you will be key to establishing
our chemical laboratory infrastructure in Dresden. Starting on January 2027, you will manage our analytical instruments, set up
testing standards, and verify the quality of incoming materials and
facility chemical systems. Collaborating closely with our advanced
teams in Taiwan and leading a small group of local technicians, you
will directly safeguard the production quality of Europe's newest
premier semiconductor fab! Tasks Lab Infrastructure Setup: Design,
establish, and optimize our on-site chemical lab capacity, process
setups, and analytical capabilities. Instrument Management: Lead the
operation, calibration, and maintenance of high-precision analytical
equipment, with a focus on ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, and Ion
Chromatography (IC). Material Quality Control: Execute routine and
event-triggered monitoring of incoming chemicals and raw materials to
ensure strict compliance with manufacturing standards. Technical
Writing: Define Operational Instructions (OIs) and Standard Operating
Procedures (SOPs) for the laboratory environment. Team Leadership:
Supervise, train, and coordinate a small, dedicated group of
laboratory technicians. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with
fab and facility teams to troubleshoot chemical events, support
continuous improvement projects (CIP), and verify tool certifications.
Emergency On-Duty Support: Participate in weekend and night-shift
on-duty rotations to handle urgent chemical safety or quality
escalations. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s
degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Material Science, or a
related scientific discipline. Technical Experience: 0 to 3 years of
hands-on experience in chemical analysis, with deep knowledge of
analytical techniques such as ICP-MS, GC-MS, PTR-MS, or Ion
Chromatography (IC). Analytical Skillset: Experience in standard
sample preparation, calibration curves, statistical process control
(SPC) data interpretation, and analytical instrument troubleshooting.
Soft Skills: Strong collaborative mindset, intercultural openness,
resilience under pressure, and a structured, detail-oriented approach
to safety and quality. Languages: Fluency in English (written and
spoken) is required. Nice-to-Have: Prior experience in a semiconductor
manufacturing environment or cleanroom chemical lab management.
Knowledge of European chemical regulations (such as REACH) and safety
standards. Basic programming skills (e.g., Python, R, or SQL) for
analytical data processing. Basic communication skills in German
and/or Mandarin. We offer Security & Perspective: A permanent
employment contract and career advancement opportunities in one of
Europe's leading semiconductors fabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial
Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company
pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from
TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan
(ESPP). Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer Training Center,
gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved in operating
complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training,
while you continuously expand your knowledge. Health & Well-Being: An
annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for sports
classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals &
Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized
public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional
contact details Please apply with your english resume.

jobs.occupation: Supplier Quality Engineer – Semiconductor Materials (m/f/d) (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: Supplier Quality Engineer – Semiconductor Materials
(m/f/d) Starting on January 27, you can become a key safeguard for
Europe’s newest, most advanced semiconductor manufacturing process.
As a Supplier Quality Engineer – Semiconductor Materials (m/f/d) at
ESMC, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability
of all incoming materials and services used in our Dresden fabrication
facility. By collaborating with global suppliers and our internal
engineering, procurement, and laboratory teams, you will establish a
stable quality baseline that matches our mother fabs in Taiwan. This
role is an exciting opportunity to combine your technical knowledge of
material science with supplier management and big data analytics to
protect our production from material excursions! Tasks Incoming
Quality Assurance: Establish and maintain a stable statistical
baseline for incoming materials and services to ensure local wafer
quality aligns with our international mother fabs. Supplier Quality
Management: Conduct comprehensive supplier quality system assessments,
onsite audits, risk management, and process change control (PCN)
reviews. Excursion Prevention: Utilize statistical process control
(SPC) data and key performance indicators (KPIs) to proactively
monitor supplier performance and prevent material deviations.
Collaborative Problem Solving: Lead cross-functional troubleshooting
teams alongside suppliers and internal laboratory, facility, and
procurement departments to quickly resolve quality issues.
Cross-Border Alignment: Align requirements and share Best Known
Methods (BKMs) across different time zones, communicating effectively
with internal management and executive supplier representatives.
Continuous Improvement: Build trust-based, professional relationships
with suppliers to encourage proactive transparency and continuous
quality improvements. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or
Master’s degree in Material Science, Material Engineering,
Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related
technical field. Experience: 0 to 3 years of professional experience,
ideally in the semiconductor industry or related high-tech sectors
(e.g., photovoltaics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals). Core Technical
Skills: Familiarity with basic material quality management,
statistical data analysis, or process change control. Interpersonal &
Communication Skills: High intercultural open-mindedness, strong
initiative, and the confidence to communicate effectively with
international teams and senior management. Languages: Fluent in
English (written and spoken) is required. Nice-to-Have: Practical
experience in semiconductor fabrication operations, process
engineering, or physical/chemical laboratory analysis. Familiarity
with structured problem-solving methods (e.g., 8D, 5 Whys) and
supplier auditing. Basic conversational skills in German and/or
Mandarin. We offer Security & Perspective: A permanent employment
contract and career advancement opportunities in one of Europe's
leading semiconductors fabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial
Benefits: We support your financial well-being with our robust company
pension plan. As an ESMC employee, you also benefit directly from
TSMC’s performance through an exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan
(ESPP). Relocation Support for Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide
you with all the support you will need for your relocation and your
start in Dresden. Training & Development: At the TSMC Newcomer
Training Center, gain a deeper understanding of the processes involved
in operating complex semiconductor equipment through unique hands-on
training, while you continuously expand your knowledge. Health &
Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being (e.g., for
sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stay fit. Meals &
Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as a subsidized
public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket). Additional
contact details Please apply with your english resume.

jobs.occupation: SPC & Metrology Quality Engineer (m/f/d) (Qualitätsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH is
the joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the first
time, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab in
the heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologies
for next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a shared
commitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. For
our future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated and
committed: SPC & Metrology Quality Engineer (m/f/d) Are you passionate
about turning complex production data into robust manufacturing
stability? As an SPC & Metrology Quality Engineer (m/f/d) at ESMC, you
will be at the heart of our quality defense team in Dresden. Starting on January 2027, you will take ownership of the quality, calibration,
and tool matching of inline metrology systems (such as OCD, CDSEM, and
Overlay). Simultaneously, you will drive our Statistical Process
Control (SPC) system enhancements to predict manufacturing risks,
analyze data trends, and prevent process deviations. This role is a
unique opportunity to combine physical engineering with advanced
statistical analysis in a brand-new, state-of-the-art semiconductor
fab. Tasks Metrology Quality Assurance: Oversee the performance and
accuracy of critical inline metrology tools (including CDSEM, OCD, and
Overlay) to ensure stable process measurement. Tool Performance
Matching: Develop, implement, and monitor calibration and cross-fab
matching methods to guarantee uniform measurements across all
metrology tools. SPC System Enhancement: Drive the continuous
improvement of SPC systems, including control limit setup, CPK
monitoring, process audits, and data analysis. Statistical Analysis &
Risk Prevention: Apply advanced statistical methods (such as Design of
Experiments (DOE), sampling plans, and reliability modeling) to
predict risks and resolve quality issues. Data-Driven Development:
Program and develop custom statistical algorithms and analysis scripts
to automate quality monitoring and defense reporting. HQ
Collaboration: Partner with engineering teams at our Taiwan
headquarters to align local metrology and SPC standards with global
best practices. Profile Must-Have: Education: Bachelor’s or
Master’s degree in Material Engineering, Statistics, Industrial
Engineering, Physics, or a closely related technical field.
Professional Background: 0 to 3 years of experience in high-tech
manufacturing, ideally within the semiconductor industry. Statistical
Foundation: Strong knowledge of Statistical Process Control (SPC)
procedures, CPK analysis, and statistical evaluation techniques.
Programming Skills: Proficiency in statistical software/programming
languages such as JMP or R. Languages: Fluent in English (written and
spoken) for everyday communication in our international company.
Onboarding: Readiness to participate in an extended, hands-on training

jobs.description:
The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research withexcellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranksfirst among universityhospitalsin North Rhine-Westphalia andsecond nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.

The arbovirus research group of PD Dr. Beate Kümmerer at the Institute of Virology at the University Hospital Bonn (Germany) is looking for a highly motivated

PhD student (m/f/d)

to join our team and explore the fascinating biology of orthoflavivirus-host interaction in mosquitoes and vertebrates. The PhD position (65% E13 salary according to DFG recommendations), initially limited to three years, is advertisedwithin the framework of the DFG-funded CRC/Transregio 237 “Nucleic Acid Immunity” and is to be filled by January 2027.

The position is offered on a fixed-term basis until December 31, 2029.
Mosquito-borne RNA viruses, such as dengue, yellow fever, and Zika virus, cause severe disease outbreaks worldwide. As climate change drives the spread of mosquito vectors, the regions affected by these viruses continue to expand. Orthoflaviviruses have evolved multiple strategies to evade innate immune recognition, thereby promoting viral replication and pathogenesis. The project aims to elucidate how viral RNA structures and RNA modifications shape innate immune recognition. A particular focus will be the identification of mosquito proteins that recognize viral cap0 RNA and the characterization of viral immune antagonists in both mosquito and vertebrate hosts. We hope to gain mechanistic insights into virus-host interactions that support the development of innovative antiviral therapies and sustainable vector control strategies.

Methods: Molecular biology methods, cell culture and virological methods, RNA-protein and protein-protein interaction studies, gene expression analyses, cellular knock-down, as well as research involving mosquitoes.

Master’s degree in life sciences
Enthusiasm for research in a collaborative environment
Commitment to the research project
Profound knowledge in basic molecular biological methods and cell culture
Experience in virology and/or protein-RNA/protein interaction studies would be ideal

Interest in working with live mosquitoes
Motivation to learn new methods
Fluent oral and written English

A 3-year PhD position (65% TV-L E13) with strong mentoring and integration into a high-profile research network (CRC/Transregio 237)
An interdisciplinary research environment at one of Germany’s top universities
A highly collaborative research team

Access to further education in university and non-university courses

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral positions in Research Area III of the Cluster of Excellence RESOLV (m,f,x) (Analytiker/in - Chemie)
jobs.description:
In order to fill a fixed-term position in full-time (39.83 hours/week = 100%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for collective call for applications for all PIs and PSs in RESOLV

Postdoctoral positions in Research Area III of the Cluster of Excellence RESOLV (m,f,x)

RESOLV is a world-leading interdisciplinary research project in Solvation Science awarded as a Cluster of Excellence by the German Excellence Strategy. Within RESOLV, more than 200 scientists at six institutions in the Ruhr area, covering experimental chemistry, theory, chemical physics, and chemical engineering, investigate how solvents are involved in the control, mediation and regulation of chemical reactions and processes. The research focuses on three main areas: I) Charge and Electron Transfer: The Solvent in Action, II) Solvent Design for Chemical Processes, and III) Tuning Stability and Homogeneity. RESOLV’s mission stretches from fundamental research to applications and products. For more information, please refer to our website (www.solvation.de).

RESOLV has established a structured postdoctoral training platform with emphasis on both individual research training and career coaching in academia, industry, and entrepreneurship. We are looking for full-time postdoctoral researchers for two-year temporary subprojects (39.83 h/week, payment according to public service’s wage agreement TV-L E13) with an excellent track record.

Scope: full-time
Duration: fixed-term, 2 years
Start: at the earliest possible date
Apply by:  2026-09-29

Your tasks:

- As postdoctoral researcher in Area III, you will contribute to the design of highly stable formulations, preventing phase changes while maintaining the functionality of active molecules, such as chemical entities or biomolecules. Drawing on the remarkable influence of the liquid environment, RESOLV aims to improve the applicability of hydrophobic pharmaceuticals by crafting customized mesophase structures to overcome the limitations of low solubility and bioavailability. Further major goals are to uncover the mechanism by which enzymes become more active in the specific solvent environment of liquid condensates induced by liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS) and to map local hydration changes and LLPS even in living cells.

Your profile:

- You hold a top-grade full university degree with a doctorate in Chemistry, Physics, Biochemistry, Chemical Engineering or comparable subjects.
- You are fascinated by the interdisciplinary research field Solvation Science.
- You have experience in one of the following disciplines: chemical engineering (thermodynamic measurements and modelling, formulation design), (bio-) physical chemistry, (time-resolved) spectroscopic techniques, theoretical chemistry (simulations or electronic structure calculations), as well as (cellular) biochemistry and protein engineering.
- You have a solid knowledge of English in a professional environment (at least level B2, oral and written).
